cardOverview.overviewText: A Solitaire card from IndusInd offering milestone jewellery vouchers, lifestyle rewards, and exclusive privileges for women customers.

benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail your EazyDiner membership, check your email for the activation link and membership details. Visit the EazyDiner website or open the app, then register or log in using the details provided. Enter any promo or membership code you received to activate your benefits. Once activated, enjoy exclusive dining offers and priority reservations.

benefitRows.name: Golf
benefitRows.offer: Customers can access 12 rounds of complimentary green fees annually, limited to 3 rounds per calendar quarter, along with 4 guest green fee accesses, capped at 1 per quarter, and 12 complimentary golf lessons yearly, with a maximum of 3 per quarter.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Access the designated golf booking portal using the email ID registered with your credit card. Choose your preferred golf course, date, and time, and complete the booking. You’ll receive a confirmation via email, take this with you when you play. Note that additional costs like caddy fees and carts are usually not covered and must be paid at the course.
